verifications.note: 2022 CCXI (中诚信国际) tracking rating report on 江西省天然气集团有限公司. Footnote quoted verbatim in the sibling shard P4791: the PHASE I network ('一期管网工程', 川气东送-sourced, run by the 54%-group/46%-PipeChina-subsidiary JV 江西省天然气管道有限公司) explicitly covers '南昌、九江、景德镇、新余、宜春、抚州、鹰潭、上饶等42个县市' -- i.e. Yingtan (鹰潭) prefecture is named under PHASE I coverage, not Phase II.

2011-01-06 corporate repost (新天科技/Suntront) of a Jiangxi provincial gas-network planning article, hand-verified by curl (not WebFetch) and read directly. Verbatim: '即将全面开工建设的省天然气管网二期工程，以西二线在江西省境内分输站为起点，建设至各设区市中心城市、县(市、区)中心城市及工业园区的长输高压管网。管网工程涉及南昌、九江、宜春、新余、萍乡、吉安、赣州、上饶、鹰潭9个设区市，39个县(市、区)。预计2011年各设区市中心城区率先建成通气，2012年全线建成并具备通气条件' -- explicitly lists Yingtan (鹰潭) as ONE OF THE 9 target prefecture cities of the PLANNED, WEP2-sourced PHASE II provincial network. This directly conflicts with the CCXI footnote's placement of Yingtan under Phase I.

Per the sibling shards P4946/P4944 (verbatim quote carried there), this MEE 2016 East-section completion-acceptance letter exhaustively names exactly FIVE WEP2 East-section components (甘陕界～广州干线, 樟树～湘潭联络线, 广州～南宁支干线, 广州～深圳支干线, 南昌～上海支干线) -- 余江-鹰潭/鹰潭支线 is NOT among them, so this branch is not a national-PipeChina-built East-section component in the same sense as P4946/P4944.

Evidence is genuinely THREE-WAY mixed, not resolved here: (1) the sheet's current Operator/Owner values are PipeChina itself (and per the wiki, specifically PipeChina's own 西气东输分公司 regional transmission branch) -- consistent with GEM's naming of this row as a WEP2-named branch, but NOT corroborated by any segment-naming document found; (2) the MEE 2016 East-section letter's exhaustive five-branch list does not include this branch, arguing against a national-PipeChina-East-section reading like P4946/P4944's; (3) the CCXI 2022 report's own footnote places all of Yingtan prefecture under PHASE I coverage (川气东送-sourced, run by the 54%/46% JV) -- which would argue for changing Operator/Owner to that JV instead, a reading NOT currently on the sheet at all; (4) my own 2011 suntront.com find places Yingtan among the 9 target cities of the PLANNED, WEP2-sourced Phase II PROVINCIAL network (run by 江西省天然气集团 via 管道分公司, the model used for P4788/P4789/P4946's Ganzhou/Xinyu-cluster branches) -- a fourth possible reading, and the one most consistent with how P4793's own corridor (also terminating at Yujiang) was treated. RELAUNCH_NOTES item 9's precedent (P4791: CCXI's own footnote sometimes contradicts the sheet's Phase I/II label, and segment-naming sources trump the footnote when they exist) cannot be applied here because NO segment-naming source of any kind exists for 余江-鹰潭 -- the footnote and my provincial-planning find are both prefecture/province-level, not segment-level, so neither can override the other per the aggregate-vs-segment discipline. RECOMMENDATION for the merge: do not change Operator/Owner on this row without a primary source; if a human reviewer resolves the cohort-wide Yingtan Phase I/II question (P4793, P4794, P4795, P4796, P5861 all share it per the CCXI footnote's prefecture list), the same resolution should be applied here too.
